source.title: Lazy Disenchanter (Retail) — persistent per-item session log
source.author: Krathe

quote: Session Log — tracks every item disenchanted and the materials received, including crafting quality rank.
notes: A newly identified potential original per-item disenchant source, not a yield study. The addon description explicitly says the item/material/rank session log survives reloads and relogs until manually cleared. No public player-completed session log, SavedVariables schema, timestamped input itemLink/bonus/ilvl, profession skill/specialization, per-cast zero outcomes or exported per-operation histograms were found. Supported Retail versions listed up through 12.0.7 (June 20 2026); compatibility with current 12.1.5 has not been verified. Do not turn session features into numeric observed casts or material probabilities. Seek permissioned original saved log and verify per-cast linkage and build before any quantitative promotion.
lookingFor: Original current-Retail completed-operation input-item/quality-to-material/quality log with zero-inclusive denominators from the new Lazy Disenchanter capture lane
